test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set.

(7, 18, 75)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (First Number + Second Number) × 3 = Third Number

 
• (7, 18, 75) → (7 + 18) × 3 = 25 × 3 = 75

Similarly,

 
• (11, 17, 84) → (11 + 17) × 3 = 28 × 3 = 84

Hence, '**(11, 17, 84)**' is the correct answer.
